body: DDG celebrated his 29th birthday at Cascade in Atlanta (Oct. 9), where he also turned the night into a video shoot for Hit-A-Thon track “Georgia Wata. ” Gunna, Real Boston Richey, 42 Dugg, Bendadonnn and more were on hand as DDG filmed scenes for the upcoming visual while celebrating with friends.
